title: Chapter 70
text:
Da Hei slowly came to a stop. Zhang Wei and the other three alighted from the carriage.

"I'm Qi Bai Jia, the officer leading the team this time."

Qi Bai Jia had a solemn expression on his face as he saluted, looking valiant and heroic.

"Hello, it's a pleasure to work with you." Zhang Wei nodded. He turned around and gave Ma Qing Yang a big hug.

Lin Yao's eyes lit up when he saw Di Su Su. He couldn't retract his hands from Di Su Su's body. He waved his hands shyly and greeted her. "Sister Su Su."

"Little Lin Lin …" Di Su Su ignored Lin Yao and walked past him. She walked in front of Li Ya Lin with a smile on her face. She pinched Li Ya Lin's cheeks and said, "You've become prettier since we last met."

"Get lost. I don't know you that well." Li Ya Lin frowned and slapped Di Su Su's hand away.

Di Su Su didn't care. She glanced around and asked curiously, "Where's your mechanic? Where is he?"

Li Ya Lin crossed her arms and didn't answer.

Zhang Wei answered, "He's a little tired. He's sleeping in the car."

"This car is …"

"Our logistics vehicle." After Zhang Wei said this, he straightened his back and looked proud.

Ma Qing Yang and Di Su Su's team members were envious. They looked at their team leaders with resentment.

We want a logistics car too …

Qi Bai Jia clapped his hands and said, "Alright, it's getting late. Let's go."

A military train was parked at the station. This time, they were not taking a plane and were going by land. There were 40 field personnel accompanying them. They were all well-trained soldiers. They were busy moving boxes of ammunition and guns onto the train.

Since most of the roads had been abandoned, the Six Nations had developed railways. The military train was faster than the civilian train and would reach the destination in three days.

The first five carriages were the driver's cabin, two living rooms, a dining room, and a gun storage. The last few carriages were open-air carriages used to transport vehicles. Li Ya Lin drove Da Hei onto the train. The soldiers locked Da Hei onto the train and covered it with a dust-proof cloth to prevent it from being blown away by the wind.

After everyone boarded the train, the military train rumbled away and drove out of the eastern sentry post. Under the scorching sun, it went deep into the desolate and dangerous wilderness.

…

Han Xiao felt a vibration in his sleep and woke up.

The lights installed on the top of the cargo compartment emitted a soft white light twenty-four hours a day, illuminating the space around him. All he could see were cold machines of various shapes, but they gave him a sense of security.

Han Xiao pressed his thumb and index finger on his Jingming acupoint and rubbed it a few times. Only then did he wake up. He opened the door of the cargo compartment and found himself on a high-speed train. The oncoming wind rolled up his messy hair, and the deck under his feet was shaking non-stop. The sound of the train rushing into his ears, and the military train was moving along the tracks.

The stars in the sky were scattered, and the moonlight shrouded the sky.

In the distance, there were mountains and hills, and wild grass was everywhere.

"I slept all day?"

Han Xiao was stunned for a moment. Following the light, he walked into the carriage in front. Before that, he put on the face simulator and adjusted it to the first memory of an ordinary young man. After thinking for a while, he put on another face mask. Needless to say, that was how scheming he was.

After entering the carriage, the sound of the wind disappeared, and the sound of people talking hit him in the face. He suddenly had the illusion that he had returned from the barbaric era to the civilized era.

When Han Xiao walked in, everyone immediately stopped talking. Pairs of eyes gathered on Han Xiao with curiosity and scrutiny.

Di Su Su was the first to stand up. She swayed her slim waist and walked in front of Han Xiao. With a face full of curiosity, she asked, "You are Han Xiao?"

"You have the wrong person." Han Xiao casually replied. If I answer whatever you ask, won't I lose face?

Everyone's face stiffened. Who are you trying to lie to? Everyone is in the carriage, who else can you be?

Di Su Su's face stiffened. She just wanted to use this as an excuse, but she did not expect Han Xiao to reply like this. For a moment, she did not know what to say.

When Li Ya Lin saw that the scheming girl was defeated, she immediately felt good. She waved her hand and said, "Brother Xiao, come sit here."

Han Xiao nodded and sat beside Zhang Wei and the others. Li Ya Lin immediately whispered to Han Xiao, "Well done. You made the scheming girl lose face."

"Sex hormones?" Han Xiao was stunned. A girl with such a slutty name?

"That's her, Di Su Su. A despicable and unreasonable woman!" Li Ya Lin gritted her teeth.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and said, "Why do I feel like you are describing yourself?"

Lin Yao agreed, but he did not dare to say anything. He was afraid of being beaten. He secretly looked at Han Xiao with admiration. As expected of Brother Xiao, he was not afraid at all. He said whatever he wanted. So cool.

Di Su Su saw that Li Ya Lin and Han Xiao seemed to be intimate. Her face changed, and a trace of anger flashed in her eyes.

Ma Qing Yang, who was standing at the side, extended his hand and smiled. "Brother, this is the first time we have met. I am Ma Qing Yang."

Han Xiao took Li Ya Lin's 720-degree waist rotation and shook hands with him naturally. He said, "Strictly speaking, we have not met before."

Ma Qing Yang was stunned. He looked at Han Xiao's mask and did not know whether to laugh or cry. "You are right."

Qi Bai Jia clapped his hands and said, "Alright, everyone is here. Let me tell you the details of this operation. The field personnel can leave for a moment."

The field personnel knew that this was the rule, so they left the carriage. The environment immediately quieted down, leaving only the three secret operation teams and Qi Bai Jia.

Qi Bai Jia coughed lightly, took out a stack of information, and spread out a map on the table.

"This operation is a joint operation between us and Hesla's intelligence department. Hesla's army is stationed at the border and can be deployed at any time. Our mission is to infiltrate the enemy's defenses and provide intelligence support to the army."

"This is the map sent by Hesla. Dark Crow Valley is easy to defend and difficult to attack. The dense forest makes it impossible to detect the location of the base through aerial photography. The enemy's military strength and location are unknown, so we can only invade from the ground."

When it came to the mission, everyone became serious. Di Su Su tapped her forehead with her finger and frowned. "It sounds like a heavily guarded fortress. Can't Hesla's army invade from the ground?"

Qi Bai Jia shook his head. "They are not willing to."

Hesla's style was to prioritize profits. If they could contribute twenty percent of their strength, they would not put in thirty percent of their effort. Before the situation was clear, they would not allow the army to set foot in unexplored areas. This was to prevent accidental losses. The Covert Operations Department was responsible for such high-risk missions, where they would take the lead and enter the enemy's territory.

Li Ya Lin snorted softly. She did not want to show any weakness. She quickly asked, "Then, where is the breakthrough?"

Qi Bai Jia tapped on the map. "West of Dark Crow Valley, there is a large rogue settlement called Dark Crow Forest. Dark Crow Forest Town dared to be built near the Germinal Organization base. This proves that the two parties are secretly in cahoots. There may be spies from the Dark Crow Valley base. Therefore, this is the breakthrough, and there is a chance to obtain intelligence. "

"According to the intelligence, there are three people to be careful of in the Dark Crow Valley base."

Qi Bai Jia took out the documents and distributed them. Seeing that everyone was browsing with their heads lowered, he concisely said, "Head Supervisor Pan Kuang, male, thirty-five years old, Asian, Grade E + Pugilist, executive officer of the Germinal Organization. His weapon is a sword, nicknamed 'Sword Soul'. His most recent achievement was three years ago, when he single-handedly killed twelve Theseus agents at the border of Theseus. Four of them were superhumans.

The information showed an expressionless man. He looked ordinary, but there was a fierce aura about him.

"Not to be messed with," everyone thought at the same time.

"Deputy Supervisor Ji Ji, male, twenty-nine years old, mixed race. There is very little information about him. We only know that he seems to be related to the leader of the Wind Eye organization, Ji Nuo.

"Guard Captain Domon, forty-three years old, from Shanur, good at using all kinds of firearms. He is a super elite agent and once led a Night Owl team."

Ma Qing Yang was puzzled. "Didn't you say that you don't know the internal situation of the Dark Crow Valley base? Where did this detailed information come from?"

Everyone had the same question.

Qi Bai Jia shook his head. "I'm not sure. The higher-ups said that this is confidential."

Everyone nodded and did not ask any more questions.

Han Xiao scratched his ear. The source of the confidential information is sitting right beside you, comrades.

Qi Bai Jia continued to talk about some things to take note of. Then, he changed the topic and said, "For this joint operation, Hesla has also sent a small team of military intelligence agents. When we arrive at the location, they will move together with us."

Zhang Wei's face twitched. "Two agents working together?"

Qi Bai Jia coughed awkwardly. "Yes."

Isn't this troublesome?

Hesla was not satisfied with the information they had on Stardragon. It was obvious that they did not want to contribute themselves. That was why they requested for Division 13 to send agents to participate in the operation.

Everyone looked at each other. The relationship between the two countries was not very good. The agents were also hostile to each other. They felt that this mission was going to be a scam.

The information was not useful to Han Xiao. Han Xiao yawned and looked out of the car window. Suddenly, his eyes narrowed. He interrupted the discussion and shouted, "Beast attack!"
